capabilities: Load notes before and after the current one while scrolling
Follow the file explorer's sort order for reading order
Edit a single note in place with Obsidian's editor
Toggle between continuous view and normal single-note view
Open a folder or a note in continuous view from the context menu
extras: Desktop only and not tested on mobile. Relies on Obsidian internal APIs for the file explorer sort order, the embedded editor and how notes open, so an Obsidian update could break these; a self-test command checks them. Custom manual-sort plugins are not supported. Makes no network requests and collects no telemetry; interface is in English or Japanese.
problem: Obsidian shows one note at a time, so reading a sequence of notes whose order matters, such as daily notes or draft chapters, means opening and closing notes repeatedly.
summary: Reads a folder's notes as one continuous page in file explorer order, loading neighbors as you scroll and letting you edit any note in place.
